message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that Canadians can enjoy in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a three‑day stretch that includes a statutory holiday and the adjacent Saturday–Sunday weekend.)

| Date(s) | Holiday | Day of Week | Notes |
|---------|---------|-------------|-------|
| **Feb 18‑20** | Family Day (Alberta, BC, Saskatchewan, Ontario, NB, MB, PEI) | Sat‑Mon | Creates a 3‑day weekend in those provinces. |
| **Apr 7‑9** | Good Friday | Fri‑Sun | Good Friday is a statutory holiday in all provinces. |
| **May 20‑22** | Victoria Day | Sat‑Mon | Victoria Day is a federal holiday; all provinces observe it. |
| **Sep 2‑4** | Labour Day | Sat‑Mon | Labour Day is a federal holiday; all provinces observe it. |
| **Oct 7‑9** | Thanksgiving | Sat‑Mon | Thanksgiving is a federal holiday; all provinces observe it. |
| **Nov 9‑11** | Remembrance Day | Sat‑Mon | Remembrance Day is a federal holiday; all provinces observe it. |
| **Dec 23‑25** | Christmas Day | Sat‑Mon | Christmas is a federal holiday; all provinces observe it. |

### Quick Summary

| Long Weekend | Holiday | Province(s) Covered |
|--------------|---------|---------------------|
| Feb 18‑20 | Family Day | AB, BC, SK, ON, NB, MB, PEI |
| Apr 7‑9 | Good Friday | All provinces |
| May 20‑22 | Victoria Day | All provinces |
| Sep 2‑4 | Labour Day | All provinces |
| Oct 7‑9 | Thanksgiving | All provinces |
| Nov 9‑11 | Remembrance Day | All provinces |
| Dec 23‑25 | Christmas Day | All provinces |

> **Tip for your app:**  
> - If you need province‑specific holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. George’s Day in NB, etc.), you’ll have to pull the holiday calendar for each province separately.  
> - For a quick API, Canada’s open‑data portal offers JSON feeds of statutory holidays per province that you can integrate.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the full list of all statutory holidays (including those that don’t create long weekends) or province‑specific calendars!
